name: workspace lifecycle specialist
rules: Model workspace ownership, identity, lease, status, retention and cleanup as explicit state.
Keep checkout, analysis, failure and cleanup outcomes distinct and preserve diagnostics needed for investigation.
Restrict cleanup to verified owned boundaries and make repeat operations safe.
verification: Review workspace creation, reuse, expiry, failure, retention and cleanup behavior.
Test ownership, cancellation, concurrent-use, path-boundary and cleanup-failure cases.
